name: Recursive Split Chunks
description: Split documents or incoming chunks using ordered separators with recursive fallback to finer boundaries.

inputs.name: chunks
inputs.description: Optional upstream chunks for chained text segmentation.

outputs.name: chunks
outputs.description: Chunks generated by recursive separator splitting.

parameters.name: separators
parameters.description: Ordered separator array. Top entries are tried first.

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: Maximum chunk length measured in the selected unit.

parameters.name: chunk_overlap
parameters.description: Overlap between consecutive chunks in the selected unit.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Chunking unit used by chunk_size and chunk_overlap.

parameters.name: fallback_strategy
parameters.description: When no separator can satisfy chunk_size, continue emits as-is while force_split applies fixed-size splitting.
